headword: {中間試験|ちゅうかんしけん}

definitions.explanation: An examination held in the middle of an academic term to assess students' progress partway through the course.

examples.japanese: {中間試験|ちゅうかんしけん}の{結果|けっか}が{返|かえ}ってきた。
examples.english: The midterm exam results came back.

examples.japanese: {中間試験|ちゅうかんしけん}は{期末|きまつ}より{範囲|はんい}が{狭|せま}い。
examples.english: The midterm covers less material than the final.

examples.japanese: {中間試験|ちゅうかんしけん}で{悪|わる}い{点|てん}を{取|と}ったから、{期末|きまつ}で{挽回|ばんかい}したい。
examples.english: I got a bad grade on the midterm, so I want to make up for it on the final.

notes:
FORMATION:
{中間|ちゅうかん} (middle, midway) + {試験|しけん} (exam)

USAGE:
Typically held about halfway through each school term. The material covered is usually the first half of the term's content.

RELATED TERMS:
・{期末試験|きまつしけん} - Final exam
・{追試験|ついしけん} - Makeup exam
・{小テスト|しょうてすと} - Quiz, short test

COLLOQUIAL:
Often shortened to:
・{中間|ちゅうかん} (midterms)
・{中間テスト|ちゅうかんてすと} (midterm test)
